DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Is there anything I can help with?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 卓上のこの液体は天つゆですか。料理にかける前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 卓上の液体が天つゆか料理へかける前に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is this liquid on the table tempura dipping sauce? I'd like to check before pouring it on my food.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether the liquid on the table is tempura sauce before pouring it over the food. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その容器はしょうゆです。天つゆは別の器でお持ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: That container holds soy sauce. We've brought the tempura sauce in a separate bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: しょうゆなのですね。まだかけていません。今日は塩で食べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ調味料をかけておらず塩で食べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it's soy sauce. I haven't poured any yet. I'd like to eat with salt today.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you haven't added any seasoning yet and would like salt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 塩をご用意できます。料理に振りかけてお持ちするより、別に添えましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can provide salt. Would you prefer it separately rather than sprinkled on the dish before we bring it?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の小皿でお願いします。一つずつ、味を見ながら少量を付けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 少量ずつ試すため塩を別の小皿で依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: In a separate small dish, please. I'd like to try each piece with just a little, checking the taste as I go.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request salt in a separate small dish so you can try a little at a time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。天つゆも付けていますが、必ず使う必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. The tempura sauce is included too, but you don't have to use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: つゆは使わずそのまま置いておきます。小皿は連れの分も一枚頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: つゆは使わないと伝え同行者分の小皿も頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll leave the sauce as it is without using it. Could I have another small dish for my companion too?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you won't use the sauce and ask for a small dish for your companion too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、塩用の小皿をお二人に一枚ずつお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we'll bring one small salt dish for each of you.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。卓上のしょうゆは使わず、塩で少しずつ食べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: しょうゆを使わず塩を少しずつ付けて食べると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I won't use the soy sauce on the table; I'll eat with a little salt at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll use a little salt at a time without using soy sauce. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。どうぞお召し上がりください。

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何か確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything you'd like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で作っているのですが、私が用意した砂糖をまだ入れてよいかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人で調理する際に用意した砂糖を追加してよいか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two of us are making this, and I'm not sure whether I can add the sugar I prepared yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to add your prepared sugar while cooking as a pair. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じボウルに、お相手が砂糖を入れたか確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked whether your partner put sugar in the same bowl?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相手は先に混ぜていましたが、何を入れたか聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相手が混ぜていたが投入内容を聞いていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They were mixing earlier, but I haven't asked what they added.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your partner was mixing but you haven't asked what they put in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、足す前に相手へ聞きましょう。この練習用記録では砂糖の投入欄に印があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then ask them before adding any. In this practice record, the sugar-added field is marked.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 砂糖はもう入れたということですね。私の分を足すと二倍になってしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 砂糖投入済みなので自分の分を加えると二倍だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the sugar is already in. Adding my portion would double it.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm sugar has already been added and yours would double the amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。今持っている砂糖は入れず、作業を分担し直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Don't add the sugar you're holding; let's reassign the tasks.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私は混ぜる係にします。入れた物を二人で確認してから続けてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分は混ぜる係となり投入済み材料を二人で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll do the mixing. May we both check what's already been added before continuing?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Take responsibility for mixing and ask to check the added ingredients together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その進め方で構いません。使っていない砂糖を、使用済みの物と分けて置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's fine. Keep the unused sugar separate from what has been used.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この砂糖は使わず別に置き、投入済みの欄を二人で読み直してから混ぜます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未使用砂糖を分け投入記録を二人で読んでから混ぜると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll set this sugar aside without using it, and we'll reread the added-ingredients fields together before I mix.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the unused sugar, read the addition record together, and then mix. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。重ねて入れずに確認できましたね。続けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. You checked without adding it twice. Please continue.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもだけが乗りたいのですが、私は入口まで一緒に来てもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子供だけ乗車するため入口まで同行できるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only my child wants to ride. May I accompany them as far as the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can accompany your child to the entrance when only the child will ride. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用条件を先に確認しましょう。お子様お一人で利用できる条件か、こちらの表示で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the usage conditions first. We'll use this sign to see whether your child can ride alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表示の条件には合っています。私は乗らず、降りた後に会いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子供が利用条件に合い自分は乗らず降車後に合流すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My child meets the conditions on the sign. I won't ride; I'd like to meet them after they get off.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your child meets the conditions and you'll meet them after the ride without riding yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここでは、利用者の列と見送り用の場所が分かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here, the riders' queue and the area for seeing people off are separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ列に入れば出口まで行けると思っていました。見送り用はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 利用者列で出口へ行けると思ったと説明し見送り場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought joining the same queue would take me to the exit. Where's the area for seeing them off?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain you thought the riders' queue led to the exit and ask about the send-off area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの表示に沿ってください。乗るための入口には入らず、出口脇で待てます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Follow these signs. Don't enter the boarding entrance; you can wait beside the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 子どもには、降りたら出口脇で私を探すと伝えます。列の外から声をかけてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子供へ降車後の集合を伝え列外から声をかける方法を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell my child to look for me beside the exit afterward. May I call to them from outside the queue?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your child where to meet afterward and ask about calling from outside the queue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗車準備中は係員の説明を優先してください。出発前の連絡は今ここで済ませましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: When preparing to ride, the staff's instructions take priority. Please finish any messages before departure here now.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今集合場所を伝えて、私は見送り用の道から出口脇へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今集合場所を伝え自分は見送り動線で出口脇へ行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell them the meeting place now, then take the send-off route to the side of the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll give the meeting place now and go beside the exit using the send-off route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。離れずに会えるよう、表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Check the signs so you can meet without getting separated.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。どんなお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What help do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この映画は前に見た物の再上映でしょうか。ポスターの人物が同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ人物の映画ポスターが既視聴作品の再上映か質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is this movie a rerun of one I've already seen? The poster has the same characters.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a poster with the same characters means a rerun of a movie you've seen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用作品は続編です。タイトルの後ろに「第二章」とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This learning example is a sequel. It says Chapter Two after the title.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 第二章を見落としていました。最初の作品をもう一度見る券ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 第二章を見落としたと説明し前作の再上映券でないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I missed Chapter Two. So this isn't a ticket to see the first film again.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you overlooked Chapter Two and confirm it isn't a rerun ticket for the earlier film. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。前作と今作のあらすじを分けて置いています。内容を比べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. We have separate summaries of the previous and current films. Would you like to compare them?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。結末は読まずに、今回の始まりだけを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 結末を避け今回の冒頭紹介だけ見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. I'd like to know just how this one begins without reading the ending.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to see only the current film's opening introduction, avoiding the ending. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは冒頭の紹介です。詳しい展開を書いた冊子とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here's the opening introduction. It's separate from the booklet describing the full plot.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 冒頭だけでわかりました。続編を見たいので、今日の上映時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 冒頭で違いを理解し続編の本日上映時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The opening is enough for me to understand. I'd like to see the sequel, so could you tell me today's screening times?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Understand the difference from the opening and ask for today's sequel screening times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日の練習用上映はこの二つの時刻です。作品名と章を確認して選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Today's practice screenings are at these two times. Check the film title and chapter before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 遅いほうを選びます。券に第二章と書いてあることも確かめて購入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 遅い上映を選び券の第二章表記を確認して購入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll choose the later one. I'll also check that the ticket says Chapter Two before buying it.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the later screening and check Chapter Two on the ticket before purchasing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご購入後は入場案内もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please also read the admission information after purchasing.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この用紙に振込先の口座番号を書くのでしょうか。欄が見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 口座番号欄がない用紙が振込用紙か相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Am I supposed to write the recipient's account number on this form? I can't find the field.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a form with no account-number field is a transfer form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その用紙は相談の受付票です。振込を実行する用紙ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: That's a consultation reception slip, not a form for carrying out a bank transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 振込用紙だと思っていました。今日は操作の相談だけで、まだ振り込みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付票を誤解していたと訂正し今日は操作相談だけと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was a transfer form. Today I only want advice on the procedure; I'm not transferring yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your misunderstanding of the reception slip and explain today's visit is only about the procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: でしたら受付票に、振込操作について相談したいと書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then write on the slip that you'd like advice about making a transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金額や口座番号は、この受付票に書かなくてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 金額と口座番号は受付票へ書かなくてよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I don't need to write the amount or account number on this reception slip?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the amount and account number aren't needed on the reception slip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この学習用受付票には必要ありません。個別の情報は担当の確認時に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: They aren't needed on this practice reception slip. The adviser will ask for individual details when checking with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 口座の画面を印刷した紙は、他の人に見えないようにしまっておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 口座画面の印刷を他人に見せずしまうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll keep the printout of my account screen put away so other people can't see it.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll put away the account-screen printout so others can't see it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、順番が来たら担当へ見せてください。受付番号はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, show it to the adviser when your turn comes. Here's your reception number.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相談内容だけを書いて番号で待ち、送金は相談後に自分で決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相談内容だけ記入し番号で待って送金は相談後に判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write only the subject of the consultation and wait for my number, then decide myself about sending money after the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write only the consultation topic, wait by number, and decide about the transfer after consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お呼びするまでそちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYG-SHIOGAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please wait over there until you're called.

DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 現地見学の前に、この写真で確認します。今日の担当を、予定表からどう読み取りましたか。
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before the site visit, we'll check using this photograph. What did you understand today's assignment to be from the schedule?

DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「空のバケツの準備」とありました。バケツを持って牛のいる所まで入る担当かと思ったのですが、そこまで含まれますか。
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 担当表の空バケツ準備が動物のいる場所への運搬まで含むか確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says prepare empty buckets. I thought that meant taking the buckets into the area where the cows are. Does it include that?
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether preparing empty buckets on the assignment chart includes carrying them into the animal area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この予定表だけで動物のいる場所へ入るとは判断しないでください。現地の担当者から、準備の場所と立入りの範囲を説明してもらいます。
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't conclude from this schedule alone that you're to enter the animal area. The on-site person will explain where to prepare them and the limits of access.

DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 運ぶ先も自分で決めないのですね。写真の黄色い線の内側に立てばよい、と先に覚えておいてよいですか。
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 運搬先を自分で決めないと理解し、写真の黄色い線を立つ場所として覚えてよいか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I don't decide where to carry them myself either. May I remember in advance that I should stand inside the yellow line in the photo?
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand you won't decide the destination yourself and ask whether to memorize the photo's yellow line as the standing area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真の線だけを安全な立ち位置の保証にしてはいけません。現地の配置も確認が必要です。見学前に担当へ尋ねる質問を書きましょう。
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-05.translation: The line in a photograph alone is no guarantee of a safe standing position. We also need to check the actual site arrangement. Let's write questions for the person in charge before visiting.

DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「どこで待つか」「バケツをどこへ置くか」を書きます。この写真の奥の牛は餌を食べていないようですが、病気だと報告するのですか。
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待機場所とバケツ置場を質問票へ書き、写真の牛が餌を食べていないように見えることを病気と報告してよいか聞く。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll write where to wait and where to put the buckets. The cow at the back of this photo doesn't seem to be eating; should I report that it's sick?
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Write questions about waiting and bucket locations, then ask whether a cow apparently not eating in the photo should be reported as sick. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真だけで病気とは言えません。気づいた場面を伝え、判断は担当者に任せます。何が写っているか、言い直してみてください。
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-07.translation: A photograph alone doesn't establish illness. Describe what you noticed and leave the judgment to the person responsible. Try restating what's visible.

DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 奥の一頭が餌のほうを向いていない、と写真で見えることを伝えます。様子を確かめようと自分で近づく、という行動はしません。
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真では奥の一頭が餌のほうを向いていないとだけ伝え、確かめるため自分で接近しないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll report what's visible in the photo: one cow at the back isn't facing the feed. I won't go closer on my own to check its condition.
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report only that one cow in the back isn't facing the feed in the photo, and say you won't approach it yourself to check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように、位置と見たことを分けて伝えましょう。現地では、待機場所や担当への呼びかけ方も説明を受けてください。
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's how to separate the location and your observations when reporting. At the site, also receive instructions on where to wait and how to call the person responsible.

DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見学の最初に待機場所と呼びかけ方を聞きます。準備する場所も確認し、写真で覚えただけで作業を始めないと質問票に書きました。
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現地で待機場所・呼びかけ方・準備場所を確認し、写真だけを頼りに始めないと質問票に書いて説明を受けに行く。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-10.translation: At the start of the visit, I'll ask where to wait and how to call them. I also wrote on my question sheet that I'll check the preparation area and won't start work based only on memorizing the photo.
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the waiting area, contact method, and preparation area at the site, write that you won't start from the photo alone, and go for the explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 質問票を確認しました。教室での読み合わせはここまでです。現地担当の説明のときに、この紙をお見せください。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've checked your question sheet. That's the end of our classroom read-through. Show this paper during the on-site person's explanation. Have a good visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 今日の洗浄前確認では、予定表と完了記録を照合してもらいます。見比べて気づいた点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: For today's pre-cleaning check, you'll compare the schedule with the completion record. Did you notice anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 予定表の二番タンクに丸があります。でも、こちらの完了欄は空白です。丸があれば洗浄済みという意味でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 予定表の二番タンクに丸があるが完了欄が空なので、丸は洗浄済みを意味するか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Tank number two is circled on the schedule, but this completion field is blank. Does the circle mean it's already been cleaned?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask whether the circle by tank two means cleaning is complete despite the blank completion field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: この予定表の丸は今日の対象を示しています。完了の記録とは別です。空白を、済んだという印として読まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: The circle on this schedule marks today's target. It's separate from the completion record. Don't interpret a blank as a mark of completion.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 二番は今日の予定で、完了はまだ確認できない、と記録します。空欄に私の名前を書けば担当がわかるようになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 今日の予定と完了不明を区別し、空欄へ自分の名を書いて担当を示してよいか聞く。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll record that number two is scheduled today, but completion isn't confirmed yet. Would putting my name in the blank show who's responsible?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Distinguish today's schedule from unconfirmed completion and ask whether your name can be entered in the blank to show responsibility. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 完了欄へ名前を書くことはせず、照合した結果を別の確認用紙に残してください。担当者の記録を代わりに埋める仕事ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Don't put your name in the completion field; record your comparison on a separate check sheet. Your job isn't to fill in someone else's record for them.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 確認用紙に「二番・完了欄未記入」と書きます。隣にある昨日の記録を見つけたので、それを今日のものとして扱ってはいけないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 別の確認用紙へ二番の完了欄未記入と書き、昨日の記録を今日の記録として扱わないと確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll write number two, completion field unfilled on the check sheet. I found yesterday's record beside it, but I mustn't treat it as today's, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Write the blank completion field for number two on a separate sheet and confirm yesterday's record isn't today's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 日付の違う記録は区別しましょう。今日の担当責任者へ、予定表と空欄の位置を示して照会します。機器や薬剤には触れずにお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Keep differently dated records separate. We'll show today's supervisor the schedule and the blank field and ask. Wait without touching equipment or chemicals.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 昨日の紙は別にして、今日の二枚を示します。洗浄の準備を進めるのではなく、記録を照合した所までが私の担当ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 日付の違う紙を分けて今日の二枚を提示し、自分は洗浄準備ではなく記録照合までの担当か確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll set yesterday's paper aside and show today's two sheets. My task ends at comparing records, rather than going ahead with cleaning preparations, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Separate differently dated papers, present today's two, and confirm your assignment is record comparison rather than cleaning preparation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: その範囲です。確認が終わる前に、洗浄済みの札へ取り替えたり、設備の操作を始めたりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: That's your scope. Before verification is finished, don't change the tag to cleaned or start operating the equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 未記入という結果と日付を確認用紙へ残しました。元の記録は書き換えず、責任者の返答があるまで札も設備もそのままにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 未記入と日付を確認用紙へ残し、原記録を書き換えず返答まで札や設備に触れないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: I've recorded the blank field and date on the check sheet. I won't rewrite the original records, and I'll leave the tags and equipment as they are until the supervisor answers.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Record the blank and date on the check sheet, preserve original records, and leave tags and equipment untouched pending an answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 確認用紙を受け取りました。二番の記録について私から責任者へ照会します。今の照合作業はここで区切ります。お疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-02-001-SHARED-.translation: I've received your check sheet. I'll ask the supervisor about number two's record. We'll stop this comparison task here. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 材料を数える作業の前に、担当表を見てください。自分の名前はどの欄にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Before counting materials, look at the assignment chart. Which field has your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 私の名前は材料確認の欄です。隣の人は機械操作の欄ですが、同じ班なら私も手伝ってよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 自分は材料確認欄だが、同じ班なら同僚の機械操作も手伝えると思っていたと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: My name is under material checking. The person beside me is under machine operation, but I thought I could help with that too if we're on the same team.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say your assignment is material checking but you thought being on the same team allowed helping operate the machine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 班が同じでも操作できる範囲は同じとは限りません。今日は材料の本数を確認し、機械操作はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Being on the same team doesn't necessarily mean the same operating permissions. Today you'll check the number of materials, not operate machinery.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 機械の所へ材料を持ち込む所まで含めず、指定の机で数えるのですね。数が合わなかったら、隣の機械の近くを探してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 指定机で数える範囲と理解し、本数が不足したら機械付近まで探してよいか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: So I count at the designated table, without carrying materials into the machine area. If the count is short, may I search near the next machine?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Understand you'll count at the designated table and ask whether you can search near machinery if materials are short. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 探すために機械の区域へ入らず、不足している本数を担当者へ伝えてください。材料は今、何本あると数えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Don't enter the machine area to search; tell the person in charge how many are missing. How many materials have you counted now?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 予定は十本で、机には九本です。不足を補おうとして機械の近くから一本取らず、九本と報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 予定十本に対し机は九本と報告し、機械付近から一本取って補わないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: The plan calls for ten, and there are nine on the table. I won't take one from near the machine to make up the shortage; I'll report nine.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Report nine on the table against ten planned and say you won't take one from near machinery to make up the number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: その内容を記録しましょう。もし機械で材料が引っかかっているように見えた場合も、手を出さず担当者へ知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Let's record that. If something appears caught in a machine, don't reach in; notify the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 止まって見えても、私が引っかかった物を取る担当ではないのですね。知らせる相手が見当たらないときの連絡先も、始める前に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 停止して見えても詰まり除去は自分の担当でないと確認し、担当者不在時の連絡先を作業前に尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Even if it looks stopped, removing a stuck item isn't my assignment, then. Before I begin, please also tell me whom to contact if that person isn't around.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm clearing a jam isn't your assignment even if machinery looks stopped, and ask for an alternate contact before work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: この連絡表の担当名を、現場の責任者と確認します。連絡方法や非常時の行動は、実地の説明を受けるまではわかったことにしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: We'll check the name on this contact list with the site supervisor. Don't consider the contact method or emergency actions understood until you've received the practical explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 机の九本という記録を渡します。材料確認の範囲と連絡方法を責任者に確認してから、指定された作業だけに取りかかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 九本の記録を渡し、担当範囲と連絡方法を責任者に確認してから指定作業だけを始めると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll hand over the record of nine on the table. After confirming my material-checking scope and contact method with the supervisor, I'll start only the assigned work.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Hand over the nine-item record and say you'll confirm scope and contact method before beginning only assigned work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 九本という記録を受け取りました。これから責任者に連絡表と担当範囲を一緒に確認してもらいましょう。準備の説明はいったんここまでです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-03-001-SHARED-.translation: I've received the record of nine. Let's now have the supervisor check the contact list and your scope with us. That's all for this preparation explanation for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ご注文の前に、料理の内容をご説明しましょうか。こちらの煮込みが気になっていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Shall I explain the dishes before you order? Are you interested in this stew?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。ただ、ねぎが苦手です。上に載っている分を抜けば、ねぎなしになる料理でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 煮込みの上のねぎを抜けばねぎなしになるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes, but I don't like green onions. If you leave off the ones on top, would the dish be free of green onions?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask whether removing the green-onion topping makes the stew free of green onions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: この煮込みは具にもねぎを使っています。上の薬味だけ外しても、ねぎなしにはできません。アレルギーについてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: This stew also contains green onions among the ingredients. Removing just the garnish won't make it green-onion-free. Is this an allergy concern?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: アレルギーではなく、味が苦手です。具に入っているなら煮込みはやめて、こちらの焼きいもの内容を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: アレルギーでなく味が苦手だと説明し、具にも入る煮込みをやめて焼きいもの内容を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: It's not an allergy; I dislike the taste. If they're among the ingredients, I'll skip the stew. Could you tell me about this roasted sweet potato instead?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Explain it's a taste dislike rather than allergy, skip the stew because it contains green onions, and ask about roasted sweet potato. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: こちらは焼きいもで、添えるたれは別容器です。今日は味を付けないものをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: This is a roasted sweet potato, with the accompanying sauce in a separate container. Would you like it unseasoned today?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: たれなしがよいです。一人で食べるので、小さい物を一つ選べますか。大きい物と値段が違うかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: たれなしの小さい焼きいもを一つ希望し、大きさによる価格の違いを聞く。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Without sauce, please. Since I'm eating alone, can I choose one small one? I'd also like to know if its price differs from a large one.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Request one small roasted sweet potato without sauce and ask about price differences by size. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 大きさと価格はこの札でご確認いただけます。小さい物の在庫を見ますね。お持ち帰りではなく、ここでお召し上がりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: You can check sizes and prices on this sign. I'll check whether a small one is available. Will you eat here rather than take it away?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ここで食べます。小さい物がなければ大きい物へ変えず、今日は注文を見送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 店で食べると答え、小さい物がなければ大きい物へ変えず注文を見送ると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll eat here. If there isn't a small one, I won't switch to a large one; I'll skip ordering today.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say you'll eat in and will skip ordering rather than change to large if small is unavailable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 小さい物が一つあります。この札がその価格です。たれを付けない焼きいも一つ、こちらで召し上がる注文でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: We have one small one. This sign shows its price. May I confirm one roasted sweet potato without sauce, to eat here?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい、この札の価格で小さい焼きいも一つを、たれなしでお願いします。煮込みは注文しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 札の価格を確認して小さい焼きいも一つをたれなしで注文し、煮込みは注文しないと明示する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes, one small roasted sweet potato without sauce at the price on this sign, please. I'm not ordering the stew.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm the sign's price, order one small roasted sweet potato without sauce, and clearly exclude the stew. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 小さい焼きいも一つ、たれなしで承りました。煮込みの注文は入れていません。お渡しの準備をしますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-04-001-SHARED-.translation: One small roasted sweet potato without sauce, understood. No stew has been ordered. Please wait here while we get it ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 入口の「土間」という説明をお読みですね。言葉の意味か、見学の仕方についてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: You're reading the entrance explanation of doma. Is your question about the word's meaning or how to visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 両方です。土間というのは、靴を脱いで上がる部屋の名前だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 土間の意味と見学方法の両方を聞き、靴を脱いで上がる部屋の名だと思っていたと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Both. I thought doma was the name of a room where you take off your shoes and step up.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask about both doma's meaning and visiting procedure, explaining you thought it meant a room entered after removing shoes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: この説明では、床を板で上げずに使う部分を土間と呼んでいます。ただし、昔の使い方の説明と、今の見学方法は分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: In this explanation, doma means the part used without a raised wooden floor. However, separate the historical usage explanation from today's visiting rules.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 言葉の説明だけを見て歩いてよい場所を決めないのですね。ここは靴のままで、奥の板の所へも行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 言葉の説明と見学範囲を分けると理解し、靴のまま奥の板の部分へ行けるか聞く。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: So the word's explanation alone doesn't decide where I may walk. Can I keep my shoes on here and go onto the wooden section at the back too?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Distinguish the word explanation from visitor access and ask whether shoes can be worn onto the wooden area at the back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: この展示では土間の見学通路は靴のままです。板の部分は展示区域なので、上がらず手前からご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: In this exhibit, you keep your shoes on in the doma visitor passage. The wooden section is display space, so don't step up; view it from in front.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 奥へは上がりません。低い所にある札を読もうとしゃがむと、背中のかばんが囲いに当たりそうです。手前で読める解説はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 奥へ上がらないと述べ、背負ったかばんが囲いに当たりそうなので手前で読める解説を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: I won't step up into the back. If I crouch to read the low sign, my backpack may hit the barrier. Is there an explanation I can read from here?
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say you won't step up, explain your backpack might hit the barrier, and ask for text readable from the front. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: この解説用紙に同じ見どころを載せています。かばんが展示に当たらないよう、通路の広い所でお読みいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: This explanation sheet includes the same highlights. You can read it in the wider part of the passage so your bag doesn't hit the display.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 用紙を借りて広い所で読みます。この入口から全体を写真に撮る場合も、奥の撮影不可の札の範囲を先に確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 広い通路で用紙を読むと決め、入口からの全景撮影でも奥の撮影不可の範囲を確認したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll borrow the sheet and read in the wider area. Even if I photograph the whole space from the entrance, I'd like to first check what the no-photography sign at the back covers.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Choose to read the sheet in the wider passage and ask to check the rear no-photography area even for a full view from the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 奥の展示が写る構図も含め、撮影できる範囲をこの図で示しています。今はカメラを構えず、図を見てからにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: This diagram shows where photography is allowed, including compositions that show the rear display. Don't raise your camera yet; let's look at the diagram first.

DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 図では奥の展示は撮らない範囲ですね。今日は写真を撮らず、用紙で土間と板の部分を見比べてから返却します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 奥の展示を撮れないと図で確かめ、今日は撮影せず用紙で見比べて返却すると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.translation: The diagram shows the rear display is outside the permitted photography area. I won't take photos today; I'll compare the doma and wooden sections using the sheet and return it afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-MYZ-MIYAKONOJO-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm the rear exhibit can't be photographed and decide to use the sheet to compare without photos, then return it. Say it in Japanese.
